definitions.gloss: headset — a device combining headphones with an attached microphone
definitions.explanation: A headphone unit with a microphone attached, worn on the head for hands-free voice communication. Used for phone calls, video meetings, online gaming, and call-center work. Distinguished from ヘッドホン ('headphones'), which has no microphone.

examples.japanese: ヘッドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a headset and joined the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ヘッドセット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: A wireless headset is convenient to have.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ヘッドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new headset so I could chat with friends while playing online games.

notes:
Loanword from English 'headset'. In Japanese it refers specifically to the headphones-plus-microphone device; the English sense of 'headset' as a VR or AR device is covered by more specific terms such as VRヘッドセット or VR⟦ゴーグル→ゴーグル：07086_googuru⟧.

USAGE:
- Common in remote-work, gaming, and customer-service contexts. Since the spread of online meetings, the word is now well known to the general public.
- Wireless models are marketed as ⟦ワイヤレス→ワイヤレス：08509_waiyaresu⟧ヘッドセット or ⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧ヘッドセット; wired models as ⟦{有線|ゆうせん}→有線：09227_yuusen⟧ヘッドセット.
- 'To put on / take off a headset' uses the verbs ⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧/⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧, the same as for glasses or earphones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヘッドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to put on a headset
- ヘッドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off a headset
- ⟦ワイヤレス→ワイヤレス：08509_waiyaresu⟧ヘッドセット: wireless headset
- ゲーミングヘッドセット: gaming headset
- ヘッドセット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{接続|せつぞく}→接続：04367_setsuzoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to connect a headset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヘッドホン→ヘッドホン：04423_heddohon⟧: headphones — no microphone; for listening only.
- ⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧: earphones — smaller in-ear listening devices.
- ⟦マイク→マイク：00267_maiku⟧: microphone — the input device alone.
- VR⟦ゴーグル→ゴーグル：07086_googuru⟧: VR goggles — head-mounted display for virtual reality; not interchangeable with ヘッドセット in Japanese.
